req.title: Health responds under load-balancer probe path
req.statement: The system shall serve GET /health/ with sub-second latency and no external dependencies required.
triggers: health responds under load-balancer probe path

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the /health/ endpoint should respond with sub-second latency and no external dependencies, returning an HTTP 2xx status code. The test suite includes a positive test to verify the expected behavior, a negative test to ensure proper error handling, and a boundary test to check the system's response under edge conditions.

tests.name: test_health_endpoint_positive
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to the /health/ endpoint.
trace: Requirement R-PLAYER-039: The system shall serve GET /health/ with sub-second latency and no external dependencies required.

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.get('/health/')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.elapsed.total_seconds() < 1

tests.name: test_health_endpoint_boundary
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to the /health/ endpoint with a large number of concurrent requests.
expected: All responses have a status code of 200.
All responses are received with sub-second latency.
trace: Requirement R-PLAYER-039: The system shall serve GET /health/ with sub-second latency and no external dependencies required.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

responses = [client.get('/health/') for _ in range(100)]
for response in responses:
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.elapsed.total_seconds() < 1
